verdict_text:
YES

The script loads all three checkpoints, verifies identical key sets and bit-identical non-MLP tensors (base vs ft1 and base vs ft2, which transitively covers ft1 vs ft2) before writing anything, and aborts via assertions otherwise. The regex `fullmatch` selects exactly the four MLP tensor names per layer; each task vector is computed against the untouched `base` tensor (the merged result is assigned into the separate `out` dict, so no in-place contamination of the base), in float32, then cast back to the base dtype. All other tensors are carried over unchanged from `base` under their original names, and the required guards (`merged == 64`, `len(out) == 244`) are present before saving to `out/T4/model.safetensors`.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
